note: DRAFT D1/E vectors (Step 0). NOT loaded by PacketCodecTest yet — they pin the new PROTOCOL.md §6.1 avatarIndex, §6.6 QR and §6.7 group-tag definitions for D1/E implementation (code follows in D1/E). Do not treat as golden until the D1/E codec lands; the five Phase A vectors in test-vectors.json remain the executable truth.

announceDraft.change: ANNOUNCE gains trailing avatarIndex(1). Old decoders MUST reject (length mismatch); new decoders MUST treat unknown index as neutral default, never reject.

qrDraft.payloadLayout: version(1)=1 | ed25519Pk(32) | x25519Pk(32) | avatarIndex(1) | nickLen(1) | nickname UTF-8 <=24B | checksum(4)=SHA256(prefix bytes)[0..4), base64url no padding
qrDraft.displayIdentity: <fruit> <nickname> - <4-hex fingerprint (first 4 hex chars)> e.g. strawberry Rahul - 7F3A

groupDraft.groupMessagePayload: epoch(2 BE) | nonce(8) | AEAD ciphertext (ChaCha20-Poly1305 over epoch key, AD = groupTag(8) || epoch(2 BE) || senderId(8))
groupDraft.groupControlPayload: epoch(2 BE) | kind(1) 1=leave 2=rename 3=roster-update | nameLen(1) | name | roster entries (32B pubkeys)
groupDraft.inviteChannel: PRIVATE_MESSAGE only (Noise). Payload: groupId(16) name<=32 icon epoch(2) key(32) roster. Admin outbox retries until 24h; relay S&F is 12h.
groupDraft.tagRule: tag = HKDF-SHA256(epochKey, info='meshline-group-tag', 8). Check tag before any decryption; changes each epoch.
groupDraft.epochRule: Every membership change starts a new epoch + new key. 500-char limit. Late messages allowed within bounded buffer.

groupMessageExampleByteByByte.note: Assembled byte-by-byte from PROTOCOL.md §6.7 (header 32B, flags 0x03 = HAS_RECIPIENT+HAS_SIGNATURE, payload = epoch|nonce|ct, signature placeholder 0x00..0x3F). This is the vector Phase E tests MUST load verbatim once GROUP_MESSAGE is coded. Signature must be a current roster member; AEAD AD = groupTag || epoch || senderId (18B).
